name: PSFplayers photo set + measured.csv face measurements
stated_by: unknown - the set was assembled before this project and carries no manifest
note: 26,138 jpgs named Firstname_Lastname.jpg, plus measured.csv with per-face colour. An all-time set, not modern-only: verified 2026-09-04 by finding Chick Maggioli (an obscure 1950 back) present.

THE_ONLY_KEY_IS_A_NAME.problem: this source carries NO birth date, NO club, NO season and NO id. A name is the entire identity claim it can make, and design 2.4 forbids a name as identity evidence.
THE_ONLY_KEY_IS_A_NAME.what_makes_it_usable_at_all: a name that denotes EXACTLY ONE person in the whole 40,745-person universe is not a name match; it is a name plus the verified absence of an alternative. That verification is the discriminator, and it is recorded as such.
THE_ONLY_KEY_IS_A_NAME.tier: 3 - weaker than a source-native id and weaker than name+birth_date. It rests on the corpus being complete enough for uniqueness to mean something, which it is not for men who never appear in it.

hard_rules: A photo whose name denotes MORE THAN ONE person is REFUSED. It is not attached to the likeliest man.
A photo whose name denotes NOBODY is REFUSED. It is not normalised until it matches.
No normalisation. Stripping middle initials, punctuation or generational suffixes converts a non-match into a match by discarding the only distinguishing information the filename carries.

normalisation_DECLINED.what_it_would_cost: each of those 597 rests on discarding a middle initial - 'Michael M Lewis' becoming 'Michael Lewis'. That is not obviously the same man, and the failure is silent: a face rendered on the wrong person's page with no error anywhere.
normalisation_DECLINED.also: 207 more would normalise onto an ambiguous name and be refused regardless; 3,292 would still match nobody
normalisation_DECLINED.status: AVAILABLE, NOT TAKEN. Needs a ruling. A gap is recoverable; a wrong face at scale is not.

absence_semantics.status_no_face: measured.csv rows with status 'no face' are an ABSENCE claim: the image was processed and no face was found. 5,131 of 9,472 measured rows.
absence_semantics.photo_not_held: a person with no photo is an absence of the SOURCE, declared here, not one absence claim per man

_documentation_only.name: human name
_documentation_only.normalisation_DECLINED: a decision record, awaiting a ruling
_documentation_only.THE_ONLY_KEY_IS_A_NAME: the reasoning behind the discriminator, which IS enforced
